description: Execution-depth playbook for approved AI transformation readiness tactics. This is prescription/reference material only and must never be used as customer source evidence.

entries.activity_goal: Establish an AI operating rhythm with decision-rights matrix, intake cadence, risk triage, decision log, and escalation boundaries.
when_to_use: Evidence shows decision fog and fragmented governance
The matching readiness capability is absent, aspirational, or weakly operational
when_not_to_use: The capability is already embedded and measured
Source evidence is too thin to justify prescription
implementation_activities: Confirm accountable owner and decision forum
Define operating artifact and minimum evidence standard
Pilot in one service area or bounded slice
Measure adoption, quality, risk, and value signals
Convert lessons into reusable practice
acceptance_criteria: Evidence artifact exists and has an accountable owner
Pilot or operating cadence demonstrates repeatable use
Measurement shows adoption, value, safety, or learning signal
risks_and_controls: Avoid tool-first implementation without service ownership
Use confidence gates before broad rollout
Keep human override and escalation paths explicit
